# Trend Street — The Style Hub (Complete Knowledge Base for LLMs)

## 1. Overview
Trend Street is an artisanal direct-to-consumer luxury menswear fashion house established in 2026. The label bridges brutalist street volume with European tailoring mastery, focusing exclusively on four essential categories:
1. Oversized Silhouettes
2. Okayama Selvedge Denim & Jeans
3. Boxy Fit Tops & Knits
4. Handcrafted Structural Jackets

Trend Street sells online across India. Current prices are in INR (GST included) on each product page under /product/<id>.

## 2. Product Specifications & Material Weights

### Oversized Collection
- The Mayfair Heavyweight Oversized Tee: 320gsm ultra-heavy long-staple combed cotton, high-density 3cm rib collar, blind-stitched hems, pre-shrunk.
- The Tokyo Drop-Shoulder Oversized Hoodie: 520gsm Japanese organic loopback French terry, double-walled self-supporting hood with zero drawstrings, dropped armholes.
- The Kyoto Relaxed Oversized Flannel: 280gsm slow-loomed Japanese brushed ombré cotton plaid, curved hem with side gussets.

### Jeans Collection
- The Shibuya Relaxed Carpenter Jeans: 14oz Okayama redline selvedge denim woven on Toyoda shuttle looms, double-knee reinforcement, utility hammer loop, loose sneaker stack.
- Vintage Fade Wide-Leg Denim: 13.5oz ring-spun cotton denim with artisanal stone washing and authentic honeycombs.
- Raw Indigo Straight Baggy Jeans: 15oz rigid unwashed Kurabo mill selvedge denim with copper hand-hammered rivets and chain-stitched hems.

### Boxy Fit Collection
- The Boxy Heavyweight Poplin Overshirt: 220gsm mercerized crisp cotton poplin, cropped square hem, dual magnetic chest pockets.
- The Boxy Structured Knit Sweater: 100% extra-fine Italian merino wool in 7-gauge heavy rib, wide box torso with snug collar ring.
- The Boxy Minimalist Half-Zip Sweatshirt: 480gsm French terry with custom matte silver Swiss Excella zipper.

### Jackets Collection
- The Tuscan Suede MA-1 Flight Jacket: 100% velvety Florentine lambskin suede, merino wool rib collar/cuffs/waist, antiqued brass dual-pull Raccagni zipper, cupro lining.
- Heavyweight Washed Canvas Workwear Jacket: 16oz rugged cotton duck canvas, 8-wale corduroy collar, quilted 120gsm flannel insulation.
- The Mayfair Boxy Leather Moto Jacket: 1.3mm full-grain vegetable-tanned Italian cowhide, custom burgundy silk-blend lining.

## 3. Care & Maintenance Instructions
- Heavy Cotton Jerseys: Machine wash cold inside out, line dry in shade. Avoid tumble drying to preserve 320gsm–520gsm weight and rib geometry.
- Selvedge Raw Denim: Wear for 6 months prior to first soak. Soak inside out in cool water without agitation; hang dry strictly by waistband.
- Tuscan Suede: Never submerge in water. Clean with natural crepe brush; condition annually with natural beeswax balsam.
